description: Known answers for canonicalJson and sourceManifestHash (pipeline/contract.js). Any language that emits data must reproduce them: keep only id and sha256 of each entry, sort entries by id, sort keys at every level, no whitespace, non-ASCII kept as UTF-8 (not \u escapes), then SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes.

cases.name: two entries out of id order, metadata to drop, a non-ASCII id
